entries.symptom: PowerShell aborts before the installer can fetch or report a failure.
entries.root_cause: A colon immediately followed the interpolated $LASTEXITCODE variable.
entries.guard: Brace LASTEXITCODE when it is followed by a colon.

entries.symptom: A helper or binary fetch can fail and leave an unexplained installer error.
entries.root_cause: Network failures must be converted into a diagnostic and the staging file must be removed.
entries.guard: Invoke-WebRequest uses ErrorAction Stop inside catch blocks; failed downloads clean staging files.

entries.symptom: macOS/Linux installer exits from the raw curl/wget fetch, without a useful error or cleanup.
entries.root_cause: The staged binary fetch was called directly while install.sh uses set -e.
entries.guard: The staged asset fetch is wrapped, reports the URL, and removes the temporary file before exit.

entries.symptom: A valid login is reported as inactive when the account email is returned under user.email.
entries.root_cause: Installers only inspected identity.email during a staged auth schema transition.
entries.guard: Both installers accept identity.email and the legacy user.email shape.

entries.symptom: Customers copy an obsolete channel instead of the PyPI bootstrap.
entries.root_cause: Public docs mixed install channels and the package README used the wrong PyPI name.
entries.guard: Primary docs use python3/py -m pip install --upgrade simplicio-installer followed by simplicio install.

entries.symptom: MCP handshake could run before an active login was established.
entries.root_cause: Installers reported login state but registered MCP without an explicit authenticated gate.
entries.guard: require_active_login gates verify_mcp_tools after the staged runtime is installed; staging is never probed.

entries.symptom: Codex integration was installed without an explicit opt-in and hook ref.
entries.root_cause: Installers always fetched the route hook and did not require a pinned release ref.
entries.guard: SIMPLICIO_INSTALL_CODEX=1 is required and SIMPLICIO_CODEX_HOOK_REF must name a release tag.

entries.symptom: Uninstall lacked explicit keep-data, purge confirmation, and rollback markers.
entries.root_cause: The scripts removed only the binary and had no transaction-aware data policy.
entries.guard: --keep-data is default; --purge requires confirmation, preserves .env, and staged installs retain rollback state.

entries.symptom: The macOS Intel contract asserted an obsolete manifest alias.
entries.root_cause: The test was not aligned with the canonical macos-x64 target table and manifest.
entries.guard: The installer derives TARGET_ID from OS/ARCH and the regression test rejects the obsolete alias.

entries.symptom: The benchmark audit treated stale wrapper and ecosystem versions as blocking findings.
entries.root_cause: npm wrappers and SIMPLICIO_ECOSYSTEM.md lagged the 3.8.25 manifest.
entries.guard: All published wrapper metadata and ecosystem version claims match the current manifest before timing is measured.

entries.symptom: The PyPI wrapper manifest pin lagged the current public release.
entries.root_cause: Package metadata and trusted manifest digest were still on 3.8.24.
entries.guard: Package version, runtime version, trusted manifest digest, and release manifest are tested together.
